description: Request a fresh check of the offer at the retailer, and report exactly what could and could not be confirmed. request_status says whether a check was made (completed, attempted_no_result, cached, in_progress, refused); verification_established is true only when a completed check read a price. A failed or unreadable check verifies nothing. A page check confirms a listed price and availability at most — never that a coupon code works. Needs a PostThisDeal agent key; repeated requests for the same offer within minutes return the last result.
name: verify_offer
title: Verify an offer now
